translations.title: Biotin 5 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used for poor growth of the nails or hair caused by biotin deficiency.
translations.usage: Take one tablet once a day, before a meal.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you are hypersensitive to it or are a baby under 3 months old. Talk to a pharmacist if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Do not take it with raw eggs, and talk to a pharmacist if you are taking anticonvulsants such as carbamazepine or phenytoin, or antibiotics.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Poor growth of the nails or hair from biotin deficiency
summaryTable.Who should be careful: People taking anticonvulsants or antibiotics, and during pregnancy or breastfeeding

summary: Poor nail or hair growth from biotin deficiency
